steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable floor quantity validation for the tenant.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Switch the initially displayed RFP event to a reverse auction.
Select the reverse buy auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product with total quantity 10.
Set the first row's delivery location.

args.goal: On the auction create screen, set the first line item's floor quantity to 15 while its total quantity is 10, and stop with the floor quantity value visibly set.

steps.note: Set the auction floor quantity, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add two available QA vendors to the event.

args.because: Floor Quantity cannot be greater than the Total Quantity

steps.note: Assert that publishing is refused with the expected floor-quantity validation message.
